action_event.parsed_action: original JSON object or null on parse refusal
action_event.configured_candidates: proposal count before cap, not evaluations

candidate_evaluation.candidate: explicit parent-index JSON, null on construction refusal
candidate_evaluation.raw_duplicate: raw candidate hash seen earlier in same trajectory

normalization_guidance: One root model-call event becomes model_round and belongs to the root runner, not the harness.
Each raw action event maps to submit_action when parsed type=submit_chain, otherwise construct_action; retain invalid/refused subtype separately.
Each candidate JSONL row maps to candidate_evaluation, regardless valid/invalid/duplicate, with its action_id.
Root records provider calls/cost separately. Harness never invokes a model, provider, CLI subprocess or network.
Construct/search tool refusals make zero candidate evaluations but consume a model decision/action round.
A separately reviewed adapter should emit the independent oracle's normalized seq/kind format; this schema is not itself a budget PASS.
